author: Example cases shipped with the explorable-models activity scaffold, derived by hand from y = m·x + b and x_r = −b/m with binary-fraction inputs so every value is exact.
review: No independent human subject reviewer has approved these cases. Replace or extend them with independently derived cases for your model.
semantics: probe.value = m·p + b; slope = m; intercept = b; probe.x = p; root = −b/m for m ≠ 0, undefined NO_ROOT for m = 0 and b ≠ 0, undefined EVERY_X_IS_A_ROOT for m = 0 and b = 0. Parameters with |m·p + b| > 10 are rejected by the constraint probe-in-view.
notCovered: The drawn line endpoints and the probe and root points are not compared by this suite.

cases.label: m = 0, b = 2: no root
cases.provenance: Hand derivation: y = 2 for every x, so y = 0 has no solution; the root is undefined, never 0.

cases.label: m = 0, b = 0: every x is a root
cases.provenance: Hand derivation: y = 0 for every x, so there is no single root.

cases.label: m = 3, b = 5, p = 4: m·p + b = 17 is rejected
